arxiv-2304-00195.title: Abstractors and relational cross-attention: An inductive bias for explicit relational reasoning in Transformers
arxiv-2304-00195.creator: Awni Altabaa, Taylor Webb, Jonathan D. Cohen, John Lafferty
arxiv-2304-00195.description: Abstract An extension of Transformers is proposed that enables explicit relational reasoning through a novel module called the Abstractor . At the core of the Abstractor is a variant of attention called relational cross-attention . The approach is motivated by an architectural inductive bias for relational learning that disentangles relational information from object-level features.

Modenesi: University of Michigan, bmodene@umich.edu. This material is based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship Program unde
arxiv-2311-00777.creator: Jamie Fogel, Bernardo Modenesi
arxiv-2311-00777.description: Abstract This paper develops a new data-driven approach to characterizing latent worker skill and job task heterogeneity by applying an empirical tool from network theory to large-scale Brazilian administrative data on worker–job matching. We microfound this tool using a standard equilibrium model of workers matching with jobs according to comparative advantage.

arxiv-2408-11824.title: AppAgent v2: Advanced Agent for Flexible Mobile Interactions
arxiv-2408-11824.creator: Yanda Li, Chi Zhang, Wanqi Yang, Bin Fu, Pei Cheng, Xin Chen, Ling Chen, Yunchao Wei, [0.1125cm] University of Technology Sydney Tencent Beijing Jiaotong University Westlake University
arxiv-2408-11824.description: Abstract With the advancement of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLM), LLM-driven visual agents are increasingly impacting software interfaces, particularly those with graphical user interfaces. This work introduces a novel LLM-based multimodal agent framework for mobile devices. This framework, capable of navigating mobile devices, emulates human-like interactions.

arxiv-2411-09834.title: A Benchmark for Long-Form Medical Question Answering
arxiv-2411-09834.creator: Pedram Hosseini, Jessica M. Sin, Bing Ren, Bryceton G. Thomas, Elnaz Nouri, Ali Farahanchi, Saeed Hassanpour
arxiv-2411-09834.description: Abstract There is a lack of benchmarks for evaluating large language models (LLMs) in long-form medical question answering (QA). Most existing medical QA evaluation benchmarks focus on automatic metrics and multiple-choice questions. While valuable, these benchmarks fail to fully capture or assess the complexities of real-world clinical applications where LLMs are being deployed.

arxiv-2412-13849.title: 99.9%-fidelity in measuring a superconducting qubit
arxiv-2412-13849.creator: Can Wang 1,2,3,∗ , Feng-Ming Liu 1,2,3,∗ , He Chen 1,2,3 , Yi-Fei Du 1,2,3 , Chong Ying 1,2,3 , Jian-Wen Wang 1,2,3 , Yong-Heng Huo 1,2,3 , Cheng-Zhi Peng 1,2,3 , Xiaobo Zhu 1,2,3 , Ming-Cheng Chen 1,2,3,† , Chao-Yang Lu 1,2,3,† , and Jian-Wei Pan 1,2,3,†
arxiv-2412-13849.description: Abstract Despite the significant progress in superconducting quantum computation over the past years, quantum state measurement still lags nearly an order of magnitude behind quantum gate operations in speed and fidelity. The main challenge is that the strong coupling and readout signal used to probe the quantum state may also introduce additional channels which may cause qubit state transitions.

arxiv-2502-07666.title: High-resolution Observation of Mini-Filament Eruptions Near Coronal Hole Boundary and Their Response in Solar Corona Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2502-07666.creator: Nengyi Huang, Haimin Wang
arxiv-2502-07666.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nengyi Huang, Haimin Wang. We investigated mini-filament (MF) eruptions near coronal hole (CH) boundaries to explore their role in coronal dynamics and their potential contributions to the solar wind. Using high-resolution H α \alpha images from the 1.6m Goode Solar Telescope at Big Bear Solar Observatory and EUV data from AIA 193 Å from Solar Dynamic Observatory, we analyzed 28 MFE events over 7.5 hours of observation spanning 5 days.

arxiv-2503-19949.title: Automated Video-EEG Analysis in Epilepsy Studies: Advances and Challenges
arxiv-2503-19949.creator: Valerii A. Zuev, Elena G. Salmagambetova, Stepan N. Djakov, Lev V. Utkin
arxiv-2503-19949.description: Abstract keywords video-EEG, epilepsy, sleep staging, treatment effect Abstract Video-electroencephalography (vEEG) monitoring is currently the gold standard in the diagnosis of epilepsy. Manual analysis of vEEG recordings is time-consuming and requires automated tools for seizure detection. Recent advances in machine learning have shown promise in real-time seizure detection and prediction using EEG and video data.

arxiv-2503-24268.title: Time-Dependent Density Functional Theory Description of 238 U(n,f), 240,242 Pu(n,f) and 237 Np(n,f) Reactions
arxiv-2503-24268.creator: Aurel Bulgac, Ibrahim Abdurrahman, Matthew Kafker, Ionel Stetcu
arxiv-2503-24268.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Aurel Bulgac, Ibrahim Abdurrahman, Matthew Kafker, Ionel Stetcu. In nuclei with an odd nucleon number the non-vanishing spin number density is the source of a pseudo-magnetic field, which favors the splitting of the nucleon Cooper pairs. Such an pseudo-magnetic field is generated always in the dynamics of any nucleus, but its effects on Cooper pairs is significantly enhanced in the dynamic evolution of nuclei with an odd number of nucleons.

arxiv-2510-13187.title: Some problems associated with the standardization of the light curve of type 1a supernovae Journal: Radiation Physics and Chemistry
arxiv-2510-13187.creator: A. P. Mahtessian, G. S. Karapetian, H. F. Khachatryan, M. A. Hovhannisyan, L. A. Mahtessian, L. E. Byzalov, J. M. Sarkissian
arxiv-2510-13187.description: Abstract We show that the parameters used to standardize the luminosity of Type 1a supernovae in the SALT2 and SiFTO models are strongly dependent on the redshift z. Consequently, when standardized with increasing z, the average absolute magnitudes of Type 1a supernovae are artificially increased.

arxiv-2511-11034.title: CrossMed: A Multimodal Cross-Task Benchmark for Compositional Generalization in Medical Imaging
arxiv-2511-11034.creator: Pooja Singh * , Siddhant Ujjain * , Tapan Kumar Gandhi, and Sandeep Kumar
arxiv-2511-11034.description: Abstract Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has enabled unified processing of visual and textual inputs, with promising implications for general-purpose medical AI. However, their ability to generalize compositionally across unseen combinations of imaging modality, anatomy, and task type remains underexplored.

arxiv-2601-16651.title: Select or Project? Evaluating Lower-dimensional Vectors for LLM Training Data Explanations
arxiv-2601-16651.creator: Lukas Hinterleitner, Loris Schoenegger, Benjamin Roth
arxiv-2601-16651.description: Abstract Gradient-based methods for instance-based explanation for large language models (LLMs) are hindered by the immense dimensionality of model gradients. In practice, influence estimation is restricted to a subset of model parameters to make computation tractable, but this subset is often chosen ad hoc and rarely justified by systematic evaluation.

britannica-1911-reybaud-marie-roch-louis.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-reybaud-marie-roch-louis.description: Article 'Reybaud, Marie Roch Louis' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 23), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. writer, economist and politician, was born at Marseilles on the 15th of August 1799. After travelling in the Levant and in India, he settled in Paris in 1829. Besides writing for the Radical press, he edited the Histoire scientifique et militaire de l’expédition française en Egypte in ten volumes (1830–36) and Dumont d’Urville’s Voyage autour du monde (1833).

pmc-10624268.title: Effect of Prolong-life-with-nine-turn-method (Yan Nian Jiu Zhuan) Qigong on fatigue and gastrointestinal function in patients with chronic fatigue syndrome: Study protocol for a randomized controlled trial
pmc-10624268.creator: Yuanjia Gu, Yanli You, Guangxin Guo, Fangfang Xie, Chong Guan, Chaoqun Xie, Yanbin Cheng, Qing Ji, Fei Yao, Walid Kamal Abdelbasset, Huijuan Cao, Huijuan Cao
pmc-10624268.description: IntroductionChronic fatigue syndrome (CFS) is a physical and mental disorder in which long-term fatigue is the main symptom. CFS patients are often accompanied by functional gastrointestinal diseases (FGIDs), which lead to decreased quality of life and increased fatigue. Prolong-life-with-nine-turn-method (PLWNT) is a kind of physical and mental exercise.

pmc-11414527.title: Lipid metabolic rewiring in glioma-associated microglia/macrophages (Review)
pmc-11414527.creator: Yixuan Ma, Yimin Huang, Feng Hu, Kai Shu
pmc-11414527.description: Gliomas are the most prevailing brain malignancy in both children and adults. Microglia, which are resident in the central nervous system (CNS), are distributed throughout the brain and serve an important role in the immunity of the CNS. Microglial cells exhibit varying phenotypic and metabolic properties during different stages of glioma development, making them a highly dynamic cell population.

pmc-11652695.title: Pure Biclonal Hairy Cell Leukemia–Apt Diagnosis with Multicolor Flow Cytometry
pmc-11652695.creator: Shanza Adnan, Saba Farrukh, Arsalan Ahmed, Muhammad Shariq Shaikh
pmc-11652695.description: Hairy cell leukemia (HCL) is a rare B-cell neoplasm that constitutes around 2 percent of all lymphoid leukemias and occurs more frequently in elderly males. The usual triad of HCL includes pancytopenia, splenomegaly, and hairy cells in the bone marrow.

pmc-12710572.title: Materials Design and Assessment of Redox‐Mediated Flow Cell Systems for Enhanced Energy Storage and Conversion
pmc-12710572.creator: Zhiyu Wang, Yan Jing, Qing Wang
pmc-12710572.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The transition toward sustainable energy systems necessitates innovations that overcome the limitations of conventional electrochemical systems. Redox‐mediated flow cell systems emerge as a transformative paradigm by decoupling energy storage, conversion, and chemical processes from traditional electrode‐bound reactions. These systems employ soluble redox mediators to shuttle electrons between electrodes and spatially separated reactive phases (solid, liquid, or gas), thereby enabling unprecedented operational flexibility and scalability.

pmc-13169719.title: Choroid plexus enlargement contributes to CSVD progression and white matter microstructural deterioration via brain-fluid dysregulation
pmc-13169719.creator: Zan Wang, Dandan Liu, Xueli Cai, Yingying Yang, Xinya Zheng, Guanyu Niu, Jing Jing, Yongjun Wang, Yuesong Pan, Yilong Wang
pmc-13169719.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe choroid plexus (ChP) plays a pivotal role in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) production, blood-CSF barrier maintenance, and immune surveillance at the brain-periphery interface. While ChP enlargement has been implicated in several neurodegenerative and neuroinflammatory disorders, its role in the pathogenesis of cerebral small vessel disease (CSVD) and frequently cooccurring white matter (WM) microstructural damage has not been systematically investigated, particularly in large-scale, longitudinal, population-based settings.
